name: cmux
tagline: Ghostty-based macOS terminal with tabs, notifications and a browser for agent sessions.
description: A native macOS terminal built on libghostty that adds vertical tabs, notification rings when an agent needs input, a scriptable in-app browser, and a CLI for controlling workspaces and splits. It runs existing coding-agent CLIs such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode rather than providing its own agent.

pricing.notes: Free and open source under GPL-3.0.
